name: Cheetah Wild

features.name: First-reel collector
features.description: A collect symbol on reel one pays adjacent money symbols and wilds, boosted by wild multipliers.

features.name: Multiplying wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 carry up to 3x and multiply each other when they share a win.

features.name: Level Up free spins
features.description: Collecting Level Up symbols turns more high-paying symbols into money symbols for the rest of the bonus.

review:
A safari money-collect game. Wilds on reels two to four carry multipliers up to 3x that multiply together, and a collect symbol on the first reel pays the values of nearby money symbols (worth up to 100x) and wilds.

Three to five scatters give 8 to 20 free spins, where Level Up symbols fill a meter – at 4, 7, 13 and 15 collected, chosen premiums become money symbols, and at level five every premium does. 96.5% RTP. For collect fans.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
